<a id="active"></a>
## 🟢 Yanayopatikana

Vizingiti vinatokana na uchunguzi wa jamii. Michango binafsi inaweza kuhesabiwa ikiwa mpangilio umewashwa.

<a id="starstruck"></a>
### Starstruck

<img src="../assets/badges/starstruck-default.png" width="96" alt="Starstruck">

Unda hazina yenye **nyota 16**; viwango vya juu vinategemea nyota za hazina hiyo.

**Viwango:** 16 → 128 → 512 → 4096 (nyota za hazina).

[Mfano halisi](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S21](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pull-shark"></a>
### Pull Shark

<img src="../assets/badges/pull-shark-default.png" width="96" alt="Pull Shark">

Kuwa mwandishi wa **pull request 2 zilizounganishwa**.

**Viwango:** 2 → 16 → 128 → 1024 (PR za mwandishi zilizounganishwa).

[Mfano halisi](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S22](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pair-extraordinaire"></a>
### Pair Extraordinaire

<img src="../assets/badges/pair-extraordinaire-default.png" width="96" alt="Pair Extraordinaire">

Andika commit kwa pamoja katika **PR 1 iliyounganishwa**, ukitumia `Co-authored-by` sahihi.

**Viwango:** 1 → 10 → 24 → 48 (PR zilizounganishwa zilizoandikwa kwa pamoja).

[Mfano halisi](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S23](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S18](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/committing-changes-to-your-project/creating-and-editing-commits/creating-a-commit-with-multiple-authors) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="galaxy-brain"></a>
### Galaxy Brain

<img src="../assets/badges/galaxy-brain-default.png" width="96" alt="Galaxy Brain">

Pata **majibu 2 yaliyokubaliwa** katika Discussions. Utoaji ulizimwa kwenye `github.com/orgs/community` tangu 2024-02-06.

**Viwango:** 2 → 8 → 16 → 32 (majibu yaliyokubaliwa).

[Mfano halisi](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S24](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S06](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/106536) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

## 🕰️ Ya kihistoria

Matukio haya yamekwisha. Tuzo za zamani zinaweza kubaki; michango mipya haiwezi kuzifungua.

<a id="arctic-code-vault-contributor"></a>
### Arctic Code Vault Contributor

<img src="../assets/badges/arctic-code-vault-contributor-default.png" width="96" alt="Arctic Code Vault Contributor">

Changia hazina inayostahili katika **nakala ya Arctic Code Vault ya 2020-02-02**. Tukio limefungwa.

[Mfano halisi](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=arctic-code-vault-contributor&tab=achievements) · [S04](https://github.blog/open-source/maintainers/the-arctic-code-vault-starts-production-and-your-open-source-projects-are-being-archived/) · [S05](https://archiveprogram.github.com/)

<img src="../assets/badges/mars-2020-contributor-default.png" width="96" alt="Mars 2020 Contributor">

<a id="highlights"></a>
## ✨ Alama za wasifu

Highlights ni alama tofauti za programu na akaunti; upatikanaji unategemea programu.

| Jina | Hali | Sharti | Vyanzo |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Pro** | Yanayopatikana | Tumia GitHub Pro. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Developer Program Member** | Yanayopatikana | Shiriki Developer Program na unda programu kwa GitHub API. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Bug Bounty Hunter** | Yanayopatikana | Ripoti udhaifu unaostahili wa GitHub kupitia Bug Bounty. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) · [S20](https://bounty.github.com/) |
| **GitHub Campus Expert** | Yanayopatikana | Shiriki GitHub Campus Experts; kagua sheria za sasa za maombi. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Advisory Credit** | Yanayopatikana | Pata utambuzi kwenye ushauri wa usalama uliokubaliwa na GitHub Advisory Database. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **GitHub Star** | Yanayopatikana | Chaguliwa kwa GitHub Stars; nyota za hazina pekee hazitoshi. | [S16](https://stars.github.com/) |
| **Discussion answered** | Ya kihistoria | Alama ya zamani ya majibu yaliyokubaliwa; kubadilishwa na Galaxy Brain kuliripotiwa mwaka 2022. | [S14](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/31629) |

## 🗂️ Historia na ushahidi

Miundo ya awali ilitumika 2021-04-19–2022-06-09; majina ya zamani si mafanikio ya ziada.

| Picha | 2021–2022 | Jina la sasa |
| :---: | --- | --- |
| <img src="../assets/legacy/badge-arctic-code-vault-small.png" width="64" alt="Arctic Code Vault Contributor"> | Arctic Code Vault Contributor | Arctic Code Vault Contributor |
| <img src="../assets/legacy/badge-sponsors-small.png" width="64" alt="GitHub Sponsor"> | GitHub Sponsor | Public Sponsor |
| <img src="../assets/legacy/badge-mars-2020-small.png" width="64" alt="Mars 2020 Helicopter Contributor"> | Mars 2020 Helicopter Contributor | Mars 2020 Contributor |

[S02](https://github.blog/news-insights/company-news/open-source-goes-to-mars/) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

### Kisa cha Proxima

Picha na kadi zinafanana: Pioneer — mfano M0; Staffshipper — mfumo M8; Staffuser — timu kujiunga.

| Mafanikio | Akaunti | UTC |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Proxima Pioneer](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=proxima-pioneer&tab=achievements) | @JakubOleksy | 2023-06-01T17:34:35Z |
| [Proxima Staffshipper](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=proxima-staffshipper&tab=achievements) | @JakubOleksy | 2024-08-21T22:28:27Z |
| [Proxima Staffuser](https://github.com/timrogers?achievement=proxima-staffuser&tab=achievements) | @timrogers | 2023-08-16T18:28:07Z |

“inaccessible” ina maana huna ruhusa ya kuona tukio. Staffshipper: 2024-08-22 kwenye picha, 2024-08-21 kwa UTC.
